name: ze_Pt9_MOR
title: Pt9 @ MOR
description: Pt9 cluster in the 12-ring main channel (6.5 x 7.0 A, with 8-ring side pockets) of a frozen all-silica mordenite framework (NEP89-relaxed 1x1x2 primitive supercell, 144 atoms); Pt/H-mordenite is the industrial light-naphtha isomerisation catalyst (Shell Hysomer process). Framework Al/H+ sites and framework relaxation are absent and NEP89 binds Pt to siloxane O atoms (Pt-O ~2.0 A), so the global minimum is a model-PES optimum (Pt is used because NEP89 spuriously embeds Rh/Ir atoms into silica walls).
